360	Like her husband, he looks similar, because that is what one thinks about at the moment of the act. So if it is by what one thinks, what is the proof that Yitzchak is similar
361	to Avraham? Maybe she really was with Pharaoh, and she thought about her husband, and therefore he resembles
362	Avraham Avinu. Did you understand the question?
363	An amazing question, amazing. And he writes a brilliant answer, and if
364	Rabbeinu Ovadia of Bartenura were here, I would go down and kiss his feet, if he were here.
365	In the meantime Moshe kissed them for him. Did you hear his answer?
366	What is his answer?
367	He says: when does a woman think about her husband?
368	No, when she goes and does it willingly, only that he not catch me, only that he not see me, only that
369	he not come in, only that no spy come up, then all the time her mind is on her husband.
370	But here, when Sarah went to Pharaoh, Avraham knew about it.
371	Avraham knew that he sent her to Pharaoh. He tells her, "Say you are my sister." You know they will take me to him. But
372	a woman like that, you saw before your eyes that they took me, so she is not afraid. And if she is not afraid, she does not think
373	about her husband. If she does not think about her husband, in any case a child should not come out like her husband. If he is not
374	supposed to come out like her husband, and he came out like her husband, how clear it is that he is her husband's. Oh, how beautiful, oh, how beautiful. There is nothing like
375	our Torah in the world. Repeat it, repeat.
376	I don't think he understood.
377	Did you understand the answer?
378	Brilliant.
379	It could be many things.
380	I'll tell you what Rabbeinu Ovadia of Bartenura answered in his book Amar Nekeh.
381	Another answer I found in Divrei David on the Gemara, which answers this way:
382	He says the Holy One, blessed be He, changed the features of the face of
383	Yitzchak to be similar to those of Avraham, at that very moment. At that moment, in general, Yitzchak
384	was born with a different face, and two years later at the banquet, when they began to murmur,
385	HaShem made a miracle. At that moment the face changed, and since at that moment the face changed,
386	everyone knew that HaShem had made a miracle to show that this is his biological father, his true father. Did you understand
